text: 璞泰来公告，公司此前回购股份的资金总额不低于人民币2亿元（含）且不超过人民币3亿元（含），原用途为员工持股计划；实际回购最高价格34元/股，使用资金总额3亿元。公司后将975.14万股用途变更为注销并减少注册资本，并于2026年10月23日完成注销，占截至2026年9月30日公司股份总数的0.45%。注销后，总股本由21.44亿股减少为21.35亿股，注册资本由21.44亿元减少为21.35亿元。
text_en: Putailai announced that the total funds for the company's previous share repurchase were no less than RMB 200 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 300 million (inclusive), with the original purpose being an employee stock ownership plan; the actual highest repurchase price was RMB 34 per share, and the total funds used were RMB 300 million. The company later changed the purpose of 9.7514 million shares to cancellation and reduction of registered capital, completed the cancellation on October 23, 2026, accounting for 0.45% of the company's total shares as of September 30, 2026. After the cancellation, total share capital decreased from 2.144 billion shares to 2.135 billion shares, and registered capital decreased from RMB 2.144 billion to RMB 2.135 billion.
